name: Interaction Modalities
description: Fig 3a — four interaction-modality cards of the cellular interface: nutrient exchange (chemical flux), motile force (mechanical), growth rate, and electrical signaling. Each is a draft process: unit-bearing ports + a behavior contract, no update dynamics. Ports are wired to labeled stores so each quantity (and its unit) appears as a node.
